## What you did
- You polished dashboards v2 for the Orbitly launch: compact 40px widget headers with design tokens, dark-mode borders fixed, a slimmer widget menu, human-readable "Week of Nov 2" cohort labels, a loading skeleton that removes layout shift (CLS 0.21 → 0.02), and the categorical palette for cohorts — all pushed to PR #427 and verified on staging with Orbitly's workspace. [1][3]
- You moved the CSV export to a background job (PR #430): 202 + emailed signed link, streamed so Zest's 230k-row export stays flat on memory, front-end toast instead of the endless spinner. Daniel approved it; merge when CI is green. [2][5]

## What changed
- Priya tried v2 on staging and likes it, but the CSV export you removed from the widget menu is a **blocker**: both Zest and Orbitly use it, and the flag can't go on for Orbitly on Thursday without it. She wants it back, on top of the background export. [10]
- Maya answered your chartkit question on #427: ship v2 behind the flag, but keep @chartkit/react until v1 is gone — no dual migration for now. So drop the idea of migrating v1 charts today. [7]
- Rachel is asking in #support for an ETA to give Zest, whose ops review is Monday; the answer is: #430 is approved, merge when CI is green. [9][5]
- Dependabot bumped @chartkit/react to 5.0.0 in #429 — note it changes the tooltip API, so if it merges, v1 charts will need a pass. [4]

## What is still open
- **Fix the retention tooltip crash today** (your plan for the day): empty cohorts crash `RetentionChart.tsx:212` on staging — it's now filed as #432 with Sentry events from 4 users. Guard the label and show "No data yet", with a test. [1][8]
- Bring CSV export back into the v2 widget menu, wired to the new background job — hard deadline: staging solid today (Wednesday), flag on for Orbitly tomorrow. [10][3]
- You'd left the chartkit migration pending Priya's input; Maya's answer settles it — don't touch v1 chartkit for now. [1][7]
